listing.name: Legacy of Kain: Soul Reaver / Alexbeav PSXRecomp
listing.summary: Play Legacy of Kain: Soul Reaver with a player built from your matching original PlayStation disc and BIOS.

steps.title: Supply your matching disc and BIOS
steps.instruction: Use your own European Legacy of Kain: Soul Reaver disc (SLES-01301) with its single data track intact. This kit requires your own retail SCPH-5552 BIOS dump. Keep the CUE and every referenced track together when using CUE/BIN.

steps.title: Prepare the managed Windows or Linux player
steps.instruction: In Portcove, select your matching disc as a CHD and your SCPH-5552 BIOS. On Linux, use a native C/C++ compiler, CMake, Ninja and Python 3.10 or newer. Choose Play after Portcove builds the player.

steps.title: Prepare a separate Mac player
steps.instruction: Choose the official Mac ZIP from the upstream releases. Use -macos-x64.zip for Intel or -macos-arm64.zip for Apple silicon. Extract the complete kit to a writable folder and follow its README-SETUP.txt. Put Xcode Command Line Tools, CMake, Ninja and Python 3.10 or newer on PATH. The inspected Mac setup host requires macOS 11 or newer. The bundled game and BIOS generators require macOS 15 or newer.

steps.title: Build and add the player on Mac
steps.instruction: Run Legacy_of_Kain__Soul_Reaver_Recompiled from the unpacked folder and follow Generate & rebuild. In Portcove, select build-release/Legacy_of_Kain__Soul_Reaver_Recompiled as the program and build-release as its start folder.

warnings: Before replacing your kit, make a normal in-game save, close the game and keep the previous kit and memory cards. Upstream warns that save states may be incompatible across versions.
Portcove checks the first data track and the track count. Keep the entire original disc intact.
Portcove has not verified Mac setup, native gameplay or populated-save compatibility for this kit.

references.title: Updates and backups
references.instruction: Keep the complete working folder and back up your disc image, BIOS, saves, settings and overlay captures before replacing the kit. Keep the player with the folder that built it.

references.title: Linux generator compatibility
references.instruction: The bundled Linux generators require glibc 2.14 or newer and libstdc++ with GLIBCXX_3.4.26.
